productionSmokeWriteGate.failureRule: if any prerequisite capability or isolated WO-03 acceptance gate is incomplete or fails, keep production event writes at zero; do not dispatch acceptance smoke notifications to a real provider; use only the bound Kiosk configuration rollback if production runtime configuration must be disabled

inside that same event transaction, re-evaluate STUDIO-PROD-01 resource-wide current selection and require KIOSK_SMOKE_EXPECTED_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID to be the unique current item with no competing active run or current candidate
inside that same event transaction, read the active Scheduling config and require businessTimeZone exactly Asia/Shanghai, matching the frozen Kiosk runtime businessTimeZone

wo03AcceptanceMatrix.targetBindingRule: the exact on-site tablet/iPad, Safari, mobile viewport, accessibility environment, isolated endpoint/database/test-identity scope and fixture digests must be frozen before the PROD-11 authorization request; the WO-03 acceptance executions themselves remain post-authorization and pre-production-activation

schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.timeZoneBindingRule: the active acceptance scheduling config businessTimeZone must equal Asia/Shanghai exactly, matching the frozen Kiosk auth payload, before proposal generation and must be revalidated before PROD-11 Kiosk event execution

acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.authorizationPacketRule: before PROD-11 may be requested, bind an exact planned acceptanceRunStart and acceptanceRunEnd and fresh-prove the same derived schedule item is confirmed, unused, bound only to the exact canonical V2 acceptance request, and covers the whole planned run window with planned_start <= acceptanceRunStart < acceptanceRunEnd <= planned_end
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.authorizationExpiryRule: if current time reaches or passes planned_end before PROD-11 execution starts, or the item becomes used, cancelled, rebound, changed or no longer covers the bound acceptance run window, the authorization packet is stale and PROD-11 must not execute from it
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.executionTimeRecheck: after PROD-11 authorization, isolated WO-03 PASS, exact production Kiosk activation, and only on a replacement frozen runtime that implements KIOSK_EVENT_ATOMIC_PRODUCTION_CONTEXT_CAPABILITY, immediately before the first production smoke run event fresh-read the same schedule item, schedule_item_tasks binding and production_runs state and require confirmed status, exact STUDIO-PROD-01, exactly one binding to the frozen V2 acceptance request, zero prior runs, planned_start <= current time < planned_end, and planned_end still covers the bound acceptanceRunEnd

Inside the subsequent bounded smoke event transaction, the replacement runtime must atomically enforce all three predicates: the submitted event target and KIOSK_SMOKE_EXPECTED_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID both equal the authorization-frozen derived acceptance scheduleItemId, the unique current STUDIO-PROD-01 item equals KIOSK_SMOKE_EXPECTED_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID with no competing run/candidate, and the active Scheduling businessTimeZone equals Asia/Shanghai
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.selectionConflictRule: any MULTIPLE_CURRENT_CANDIDATES result, any other current scheduleItemId, any other active run exposed as current, a null current item, authentication or identity failure, or any non-success current-read result blocks the run event and forces fail-closed recovery
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.productionEventWriteGate: before the authenticated production current-selection recheck may be followed by any Kiosk run event, require WO03_EXACT_ISOLATED_ACCEPTANCE_ENVIRONMENT_BOUND, WO03_FULL_ISOLATED_VIEWPORT_AND_ON_SITE_MATRIX, REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE and OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT all PASS; otherwise stop with zero production run-event writes

allowedMutatingSequence.occurredAtRule: must parse as an instant and satisfy KIOSK_SMOKE_ACCEPTANCE_RUN_START <= occurredAt <= KIOSK_SMOKE_ACCEPTANCE_RUN_END inside the same smoke write-admission transaction

ID structure invalid or secure-client generation proof unavailable
any non-RUN_EVENT_APPLIED response for a not-yet-persisted phase
unexpected pre-existing run/event/review/receipt/outbox facts inconsistent with the exact acceptance item or already-bound smoke identifiers
occurredAt before KIOSK_SMOKE_ACCEPTANCE_RUN_START or after KIOSK_SMOKE_ACCEPTANCE_RUN_END

evidenceRequired: exact start receipt, command digest, generated runId and generated start eventId
exact complete receipt, command digest and generated complete eventId
exact-head proof that the Kiosk client uses secureId(prefix) backed only by globalThis.crypto.randomUUID() and fails closed without secure randomness
production run completed with runRevision 2 under the runId bound by the start receipt
exactly two accepted smoke event facts for that bound run
no pending review for either bound smoke event ID
completion notification intent permanently isolated from real provider delivery

writeAdmissionCapability.requirement: inside the same trusted write-admission/event serialization boundary, enforce the exact two-phase mutation budget, client-generated Web Crypto ID contract with immutable receipt binding, phase order, localSequence zero then one, expected revisions, schedule-item binding, immutable authorization-frozen smoke-window binding, occurredAt window comparison for every phase, no-third-write terminal latch, and receipt-exact replay-only exception

exact current-item uniqueness for STUDIO-PROD-01 equals KIOSK_SMOKE_EXPECTED_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID
active Scheduling config businessTimeZone equals Asia/Shanghai
